replies.What is your relationship with mathemati: Maths has always been a bit of a struggle for me. I find it too abstract and divorced from real life compared to subjects like economics or art. While I understand the logic, it often feels like a chore rather than something I enjoy. I try to keep up because it's required, but I'd much rather spend my time baking or hiking mountains.
replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: Definitely. The pressure to get the right answer quickly creates real stress. My high neuroticism probably makes me feel the anxiety more intensely than others. When I see complex formulas, my heart races. It's a physical reaction I can't fully control, which adds to the frustration of trying to learn something I already dislike.
replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: Yes, I've used a chatbot to check my homework a few times. It was helpful for verifying my work, but I didn't really learn anything new from it. I just pasted my answers in to confirm them. It felt a bit like cheating, so I stopped using it for actual learning. I prefer struggling through problems myself or asking friends instead.
